L-07 Client-side score forgeability is the owner's accepted risk (DEC-20260809-001, bounded to Units 1 and 2, server-side validation required from Unit 3). Recorded as inherited context and deliberately not re-accepted here.
L-08 not_applicable is scoped to Unit 1 at this revision; it is not a standing judgement that Dino Dash will never have a database, and nothing here pre-clears Units 2-5.

Carried for later units, as analysis and not design: the record carries no identifier (no idempotency key, no stable handle, no uniqueness guarantee - any store must invent a key, and ADR-003 6.4 gates an owner key on a privacy obligation that is still open); no schema version (window.dinoDash.version is the accessor's, so presence-inference over keys is the only versioning a durable row will have); no device marker (records from two devices are unmergeable - nothing to partition, attribute or dedupe on except endedAt); endedAt is the only wall-clock field, so it is unsound as an ordering key (a mid-session clock change can make record n+1 earlier than record n) and endedAt minus sessionLengthMs is NOT the run start instant because the two come from different clocks.
